[bold #D75FFF]◆ EPIC sase-1oj[/bold #D75FFF]
[dim]  Title: [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]Cut athena's SSD writes from SASE's own churn[/bold #D7AFFF]
[dim]   Goal: [#D7D7AF][/dim]SASE stops rewriting large derived state on athena's root NVMe. The[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]runner-slot capacity cache shrinks from ~104 MB to under ~1 MB. [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]Codex launches stop rebuilding a 347 MB thread index (and start ~3 [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]minutes sooner). The corrupt bead read-model cache heals itself [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]instead of rebuilding and rolling back on every read. sase-core [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]test builds link ~2.9 GB less per cycle. No admission decision, [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]Codex transcript, or bead read result changes.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim] Counts: [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]6[dim][/bold #D7AFFF] phases[dim][/dim] · [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]3[dim][/bold #D7AFFF] waves[/dim]

[dim] Prompt: [#87AFFF][/dim]prompts/202610/athena_disk_write_diet.md[/#87AFFF]
[dim]   Bead: [#87AFFF][/dim]sase-1oj[/#87AFFF]

[dim]  1 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Prune never-live dirs from the capacity_only scan[/bold #D7AFFF]             [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]core-capacity-prune[dim] · [dim][/dim]no dependencies[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]core-capacity-prune: in sase-core's agent_scan scanner, extend the [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]capacity_only skip to drop stopped (and, per the decision, dead-pid) [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]artifact dirs. A neutrality post-pass re-admits lineage, owner-key, and [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]clan-tribe neighbours, and differential tests prove admission decisions [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]are unchanged.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  2 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Self-heal the corrupt bead read-model cache[/bold #D7AFFF]                   [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]core-read-model-heal[dim] · [dim][/dim]no dependencies[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]core-read-model-heal: in sase-core's bead read model, classify [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]SQLITE_CORRUPT write faults and repair them by REINDEX or an in-place [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]table recreate. Stop swallowing invalidation failures, back off after [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]failed rebuilds, never downgrade a newer cache, and add a regression [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]test that reproduces athena's corrupt meta index.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  3 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Consolidate sase-core integration-test binaries[/bold #D7AFFF]               [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]core-test-binaries[dim] · [dim][/dim]after core-capacity-prune, core-read-model-heal[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]core-test-binaries: merge sase_core's 23 and sase_macro_lsp's 10 [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]integration-test files into one binary per crate. Isolate tests that [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]mutate process-global state, update every --test reference, and record [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]the before/after link bytes.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  4 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Adopt the pruned capacity scan in sase[/bold #D7AFFF]                        [bold black on #87D7FF] small  [/bold black on #87D7FF]
    [#AF87FF]sase-capacity-adopt[dim] · [dim][/dim]after core-capacity-prune, core-read-model-heal[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]sase-capacity-adopt: ratchet sase-core-revision.txt past both core [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]phases, add a Python differential admission test through the real [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]binding, sweep stale scan-cache temp files, and update the capacity_only[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]docstring and runner-slot docs.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  5 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Stop per-launch Codex thread backfill[/bold #D7AFFF]                         [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]codex-private-sessions[dim] · [dim][/dim]no dependencies[/#AF87FF][/dim]

    [#D7D7AF]tree whose today/tomorrow day dirs link to the real rollout store. [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]Rescue stray rollouts at teardown, sweep orphaned shadow homes safely, [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]and update the Codex provider docs.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  6 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Measure the write reduction on athena[/bold #D7AFFF]                         [bold black on #87D7FF] small  [/bold black on #87D7FF]
    [#AF87FF]verify-athena[dim] · [dim][/dim]after core-test-binaries, sase-capacity-adopt, [/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#AF87FF][dim]codex-private-sessions[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]verify-athena: once the host runs the landed code (propose the reinstall[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]through a gate if not), re-measure each source and athena's daily [/#D7D7AF]
